title: livistona rotundifolia var. microcarpa
intro: Livistona rotundifolia var. microcarpa, commonly known as the Dwarf Fan Palm, is a plant species in the family Arecaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, to treat various health conditions. Livistona rotundifolia var. microcarpa is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as pain relief and wound healing.
